The capital of France is Paris.

The author's primary motive is to highlight individual heroism and pay tribute to unsung heroes, which directly shapes the thematic structure of the text. By focusing on a "young man's courage" and framing the narrative around "bravery" and "sacrifice," the author moves away from broad military strategies to emphasize the personal cost and moral weight of conflict. This structural choice serves the motive of shedding light on overlooked contributions, ensuring that the themes of harsh reality and individual resilience are central to the reader's understanding of history, rather than just the macro-level events of war.
